project_context: MITS Corporate Cybersecurity Website - Colorful Refresh
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Transform the current monochromatic (navy+cyan) theme into a vibrant, multi-hued 'Prismatic Enterprise' aesthetic while maintaining enterprise trustworthiness.
Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic flat colors. Create depth using dark slate backgrounds layered with colorful, blurred glowing orbs.
Replace flat cyan accents with rich, multi-color gradients and a diverse set of jewel-tone accents (Emerald, Violet, Amber, Rose, Royal Blue).
Never use pure black or flat navy. Use bg-slate-950 as the deepest background, tinted with ambient colored glows.
Ensure high contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA over dark backgrounds. Use text-shadow on text placed over glowing backgrounds.
Buttons should use modern, pill-shaped or slightly rounded styles with vibrant gradient backgrounds and interaction animations.
Card hovers should feature distinct, colorful glows (e.g., using box-shadow with rgba values of violet, emerald, or blue) instead of just cyan borders.

For lists or mapped components (like IndustryCard, ValueCard, CapabilityCard), cycle through a predefined array of vibrant colors (e.g., Violet, Blue, Emerald, Rose, Amber) based on the index to make the grid inherently colorful.
Do not break existing Framer Motion animations or layout structures; purely inject color, gradient, and glow utility classes.

typography.headings: For main hero H1s and section H2s, apply 'bg-gradient-to-r from-emerald-300 via-cyan-400 to-blue-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent' instead of solid text, varying the gradient colors per section (e.g., use violet-to-fuchsia for 'Solutions').
typography.overlines: Replace 'text-cyan-500' with vibrant, context-specific jewel tones (text-violet-400, text-emerald-400, text-amber-400, text-rose-400).

visual_enhancers.ambient_glows: Inject absolute positioned divs with 'blur-[100px] opacity-30' behind hero sections and major grids. Use colors like bg-violet-600, bg-emerald-600, and bg-blue-600 to create a colorful aurora effect on the slate-950 background.
visual_enhancers.borders: Instead of static border-navy-900/10, use border-white/5 for resting states, and transition to a vibrant colored border on hover.
visual_enhancers.icons: Change icon containers from flat 'bg-navy-900 text-cyan-400' to subtle gradient backgrounds (e.g., 'bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500/20 to-fuchsia-500/20 text-fuchsia-400') or use the array-cycling color approach.

layouts.instructions: Keep existing grid structures (bento boxes, staggered cards). Focus strictly on modifying the color classes within the existing layout.

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Global Search & Replace: Update 'bg-navy-900', 'bg-navy-950', and 'bg-navy-800' globally across all pages and components to use 'bg-slate-950', 'bg-slate-900', or 'bg-slate-900/50' for a darker, more neutral canvas that allows colors to pop.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Dynamic Card Colors: In 'src/components/Cards.jsx', modify SolutionCard, IndustryCard, ValueCard, and CapabilityCard to accept a 'colorTheme' or use their 'index' prop to assign one of 5 distinct colors (Emerald, Violet, Blue, Rose, Amber). Update their icon colors, borders, and hover shadows dynamically based on this color.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Hero Makeovers: In 'src/pages/Home.jsx', 'src/pages/About.jsx', etc., inject massive blurred, colored orbs (divs with blur-3xl or blur-[120px]) in the background to create a rich, colorful environment.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: Text & Overlines: Go through all pages and replace the static 'text-cyan-400' / 'text-cyan-500' utility classes on overlines and highlights with varied vibrant colors (e.g., text-violet-400 for AI solutions, text-emerald-400 for security, text-rose-400 for warnings).
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Buttons: In 'src/components/CtaButton.jsx' (or wherever buttons are defined), redesign the 'primary' variant to be a rich gradient: 'bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-500 to-violet-600 text-white hover:from-indigo-400 hover:to-violet-500 shadow-lg shadow-violet-500/25'.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Ensure contrast is maintained. Since the base is shifting to slate-950 (very dark), most text should remain text-slate-300 or text-white.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not remove any 'data-testid' attributes or break Framer Motion 'StaggerItem' / 'TiltCard' wrappers.

colorful_abstract_hero.description: Floating metallic cubes in shades of blue and purple. Good for a secondary hero or blog header background.

colorful_abstract_fluid.description: Red, blue, and black abstract fluid shape. Good for an energetic 'About Us' or 'Contact' background accent.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text. Be extremely careful with text placed directly over the new colorful gradients. Use text-shadow or a dark overlay if needed.
